_note2: es/de/fr frames open with {lead}: the builder joins the localized title to the type phrase with an em-dash, or with a full stop when the title already contains an em-dash or a pipe, so no overview ever shows two dashes in a row. typeOverrides fixes products whose overview type is inferred wrongly from a category slug (a glasses case sitting in the wine-box category, etc).
